info.title: GovCon Teaming Partner & Subcontracting Plan API
info.description: Stateless GovCon capture & legal compliance microservice that analyzes RFP requirements against a bidder's capability statement to identify capability/clearance/past-performance gaps, compute a compliant Prime/Subcontractor workshare split under 13 CFR § 125.6 and FAR 52.219-14 (the 50% Limitations on Subcontracting & Ostensible Subcontractor rule), draft ready-to-paste FAR Subpart 9.6 Teaming Agreement clauses, and generate a BD partner recruitment outreach template.

post.summary: Generate a FAR/SBA-Compliant Teaming Strategy, 13 CFR 125.6 Workshare Split & Teaming Agreement Clauses
post.description: Accepts RFP requirements and a bidder capability statement, identifies capability/clearance/past-performance gaps, computes a compliant Prime/Subcontractor workshare split under 13 CFR § 125.6 and FAR 52.219-14 (the 50% Limitations on Subcontracting & Ostensible Subcontractor rule), drafts ready-to-paste FAR Subpart 9.6 Teaming Agreement clauses, and generates a partner recruitment outreach template.

example.rfp_text: SOLICITATION FA8732-26-R-0088 (SDVOSB Set-Aside | NAICS 541512): Enterprise Zero-Trust Cloud Migration, 24x7x365 Cleared SOC Monitoring (Top Secret Facility Clearance Required), and Legacy COBOL Mainframe Modernization. Section L/M requires 3 relevant past performance citations >$5M each and CMMC Level 2 certification.
example.bidder_capabilities: Apex Cyber Defense LLC: Verified SDVOSB (NAICS 541512/541519), Secret Facility Clearance (no Top Secret FCL yet), CMMC Level 2 certified, 2 strong DoD Zero-Trust Cloud Migration past performances ($6.2M and $4.8M), but no legacy COBOL mainframe modernization experience.

200.description: Successful GovCon Teaming Strategy, 13 CFR 125.6 Workshare Audit & Teaming Agreement Clauses

example.solicitation_title: USAF Enterprise Zero-Trust Cloud Migration & Cleared SOC (FA8732-26-R-0088 | SDVOSB Set-Aside)
example.recommended_teaming_structure: SDVOSB Prime (56% Workshare) + 1 Top Secret Cleared Similarly Situated SDVOSB Sub (24%) + 1 Niche Mainframe Modernization Sub (20%)
example.executive_teaming_rationale: Apex Cyber Defense LLC qualifies as the SDVOSB Prime under NAICS 541512 and holds 2 of the 3 required >$5M cloud past performances plus CMMC Level 2. Recruiting a Top Secret-cleared SDVOSB subcontractor (24% workshare) satisfies the TS FCL requirement while pushing combined similarly situated SDVOSB performance to 80% (well above the 50% 13 CFR § 125.6 floor), leaving 20% for a specialized COBOL mainframe modernization subcontractor.

compliance_guardrails: Apex Cyber Defense (SDVOSB Prime) must employ the Key Personnel Program Manager directly on its W-2 payroll (13 CFR § 121.103(h)(3)).
Combined SDVOSB workshare (56% Prime + 24% Similarly Situated SDVOSB Sub = 80%) exceeds the 50% statutory minimum with a 30% safety buffer.
Do not rely exclusively on a single large-business incumbent subcontractor for all 3 past performance citations.

capability_gaps_and_partner_archetypes.solicitation_requirement_summary: 24x7x365 Cleared SOC Monitoring requiring active Top Secret Facility Clearance (FCL) at time of proposal submission.
capability_gaps_and_partner_archetypes.ideal_partner_profile: SBA VetCert-verified SDVOSB cybersecurity firm holding an active Top Secret FCL and at least 1 DoD SOC past performance >$5M.

capability_gaps_and_partner_archetypes.solicitation_requirement_summary: Legacy COBOL Mainframe Modernization and automated refactoring to cloud-native microservices.
capability_gaps_and_partner_archetypes.ideal_partner_profile: Specialized Federal IT modernization contractor (Small or Large Business) with proven USAF/DoD COBOL-to-Java/Cloud refactoring references.

teaming_agreement_clauses.clause_title: Exhibit A: Binding Workshare & 13 CFR § 125.6 Compliance Allocation
teaming_agreement_clauses.recommended_legal_text: Upon Prime Contract award, Prime Contractor shall award Subcontractor a firm workshare equal to twenty-four percent (24.0%) of total funded labor dollars across the Base and all exercised Option Periods, dedicated to CLIN 0002 (24x7x365 Top Secret SOC Operations). Both Parties warrant that aggregate subcontracts to non-similarly situated entities shall never exceed forty-nine percent (49.0%) of total contract revenues less pass-through materials in strict compliance with 13 CFR § 125.6.
teaming_agreement_clauses.negotiation_note: Specify workshare as a percentage of funded labor across specific CLINs rather than vague 'best efforts' language so the agreement is enforceable.

teaming_agreement_clauses.recommended_legal_text: Subcontractor agrees to team exclusively with Prime Contractor for Solicitation FA8732-26-R-0088 and shall not submit an independent prime proposal or participate on any competing offeror's team without Prime Contractor's prior written consent.
teaming_agreement_clauses.negotiation_note: Essential when sharing proprietary Price-to-Win rates and technical solution architectures with a cleared partner.

example.partner_outreach_email_template:
Subject: Teaming Opportunity: USAF Zero-Trust & SOC (FA8732-26-R-0088 — SDVOSB Prime, 24% Guaranteed Workshare)

Hi [Partner Capture Lead],

Apex Cyber Defense LLC (verified SDVOSB, CMMC Level 2) is priming the upcoming USAF Enterprise Zero-Trust Cloud Migration & SOC solicitation (FA8732-26-R-0088). We bring 2 direct USAF cloud migration past performances ($6.2M & $4.8M) and are recruiting a Top Secret-cleared partner to lead the 24x7 SOC CLIN with a guaranteed 24% binding workshare in Exhibit A.

Are you open to a 10-minute NDA/teaming check this week to review our Section L/M shred?
